xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0022026-05-2102-42-51" status="unreviewed">gnyis pa rang gi lugs ni phyogs chos dang khyab pa pha rol kyi blo ngor ci rigs su tshogs shing dam bca' ba mi 'dod pa'i steng du gtong byed ces <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3809">jo btsun</rs> zer mod kyi ma khyab pa dang don ldog gzhan 'gyur gyi nyes pa gnas pas thal 'gyur gyi spyi'i mtshan nyid ni <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">he du</foreign> dang khyab pa pha rol gyi blo ngor tshogs pa la brten nas dam bca' ba mi 'dod pa'i steng du gtong byed ces bya'o||</seg></TEI>
